summary: Implemented the Tabs feature in the repository without running tests or repository code, as instructed. Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs with reactive active-tab name and bar position, animated watcher, async on_key, action_range_clicked, and @click-based mouse selection); UnderlineBar gained clickable_ranges (before width) and yields one Text with click spans appended last; Opacity now merges blended color into existing style via a new blend_style helper so click metadata is preserved; the layout resolver's Edge docstring documents size, fraction, and min_size (behavior unchanged, since the protocol already declared them); docs/reference/tabs.md added; tests appended to tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py and test_opacity.py, and new tests/widgets/test_tabs.py plus package __init__. Deviations and choices: the bar uses the displayed-tab index rather than the full-list find_tab_by_name index, because duplicate names before the active tab would otherwise misplace the underline (criterion 11); the resolver runs only over flexible padding edges so zero-width labels stay zero-width; letter search applies only to single-character keys; bar position is clamped to the displayed range; sandbox demo skipped as optional. Unverified: rich is not installed locally, so Style addition preserving meta and Text.spans access are assumed; the new tests have not been run. No commits made.
